loyalty.title: Loyalty programme settings
loyalty.description: Configure earning, redemption, validity, and programme availability.

status.title: Programme status
status.description: Enable or disable new earning and redemption activity.

earning.title: Earning rules
earning.description: Set the purchase amount required to earn one point.

redemption.title: Redemption rules
redemption.description: Define point value and redemption limits.

expiry.title: Point validity
expiry.description: Configure the supported finite validity period and expiry warning.
expiry.contractHint: Never-expiring points are not available until the backend representation is documented.

preview.title: Live nominal preview
preview.example: An order of {{order}} SAR earns {{points}} points worth {{value}} SAR ({{percent}}% return).
preview.unavailable: Enter valid earning and redemption values to see the preview.
preview.nominalHint: This preview is calculated locally using standard mathematical rounding for earned points.
preview.highReturnWarning: The current loyalty settings provide a return greater than 10%. Review the financial impact before saving.

disable.title: Disable the loyalty programme?
disable.description: Disabling changes new loyalty activity but does not remove existing balances.
disable.noEarning: Customers will not earn new points.

conflict.message: Another administrator changed these settings. Your edits are preserved. Reload only when you are ready to replace them with the latest version.

validation.amountPerPointRange: Amount per point must be between 0.01 and 1,000.
validation.redeemPointsRange: Redemption points must be between 1 and 100,000.
validation.redeemAmountRange: Redemption amount must be between 0.01 and 10,000.
validation.minimumPointsRange: Minimum redemption must be between 0 and 100,000.
validation.validityRange: Validity must be between 1 and 60 months.
validation.warningRange: Expiry warning must be between 1 and 90 days.
validation.warningBeforeValidity: The warning period must be shorter than the validity period.
validation.twoDecimals: Use no more than two decimal places.

feedback.updateError: Loyalty settings could not be updated.

filters.title: Ledger filters
filters.completeRange: Select both the from and to dates to apply a date range.
filters.invalidRange: Enter a valid date range with the from date on or before the to date.

ledger.title: Points ledger
ledger.waitingForDatesDescription: The ledger will load after both valid dates are selected.
ledger.emptyDescription: No transactions match the current filters.

adjustment.title: Adjust loyalty points
adjustment.description: Create an audited credit or debit using the customer's current loyalty balance.
adjustment.frozenHint: This customer is frozen. The backend remains authoritative for adjustment eligibility and balance behavior.

validation.noteLength: The internal note must be between 10 and 250 characters.
validation.insufficientBalance: Debit cannot exceed the available balance of {{available}} points.

feedback.error: Loyalty points could not be adjusted. Review the form and try again.
